ai_study_plan.strategy: This week is designed to help you build a strong foundation by focusing on key skills that will help you reach your target score. We’ll start with a balanced mix of math and reading/writing to ensure you’re prepared for all sections. Each day will include targeted practice and review to help you learn from your mistakes and build confidence. We’ll keep things light on Sundays so you can rest and come back refreshed.

days.rationale: Linear equations are a core skill for the Math section, and starting with them will help you feel prepared for more complex problems later. This day will focus on building your confidence and accuracy with this skill.
days.completion_check: Complete the targeted drill and review all mistakes

blocks.title: Understanding Linear Equations in One Variable
blocks.description: Review the basics of solving linear equations, including isolating variables and simplifying expressions. Focus on one-step and two-step equations.

blocks.title: Solving Linear Equations in One Variable
blocks.description: Solve 15 linear equations in one variable. Use 1.5 minutes per question. Focus on identifying and correcting mistakes.

blocks.title: Review Mistakes and Learn from Them
blocks.description: Go over any errors from the targeted drill. Identify patterns and write down strategies to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

days.task: Identify main ideas and supporting details
days.rationale: Understanding central ideas and details is essential for success in the Reading and Writing section. This day will help you practice identifying these elements in passages.
days.completion_check: Complete the targeted drill and review all mistakes

blocks.title: Understanding Central Ideas and Details
blocks.description: Review how to identify the main idea of a passage and how to locate supporting details. Focus on how to use context clues and signal words.

blocks.title: Finding Central Ideas and Details
blocks.description: Answer 15 questions about central ideas and details. Use 1.2 minutes per question. Focus on identifying and correcting mistakes.

blocks.title: Review Mistakes and Learn from Them
blocks.description: Go over any errors from the targeted drill. Identify patterns and write down strategies to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

days.rationale: Percentages are a common topic in the Math section, and mastering them will help you solve a variety of problems efficiently. This day will focus on building your confidence and accuracy with this skill.
days.completion_check: Complete the targeted drill and review all mistakes

blocks.title: Understanding Percentages
blocks.description: Review the basics of percentages, including converting between fractions, decimals, and percentages. Focus on calculating percentages of numbers and percentage increase/decrease.

blocks.title: Solving Percentage Problems
blocks.description: Solve 15 percentage problems. Use 1.5 minutes per question. Focus on identifying and correcting mistakes.

blocks.title: Review Mistakes and Learn from Them
blocks.description: Go over any errors from the targeted drill. Identify patterns and write down strategies to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

days.rationale: Inference questions are a key part of the Reading and Writing section, and practicing them will help you improve your ability to understand and interpret text. This day will focus on building your confidence and accuracy with this skill.
days.completion_check: Complete the targeted drill and review all mistakes

blocks.title: Understanding Inference Questions
blocks.description: Review how to make logical inferences from text. Focus on using context clues and prior knowledge to support your answers.

blocks.title: Drawing Inferences from Text
blocks.description: Answer 15 inference questions. Use 1.2 minutes per question. Focus on identifying and correcting mistakes.

blocks.title: Review Mistakes and Learn from Them
blocks.description: Go over any errors from the targeted drill. Identify patterns and write down strategies to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

days.rationale: Linear functions are a core skill for the Math section, and understanding them will help you solve a variety of problems efficiently. This day will focus on building your confidence and accuracy with this skill.
days.completion_check: Complete the targeted drill and review all mistakes

blocks.title: Understanding Linear Functions
blocks.description: Review the basics of linear functions, including slope, intercepts, and graphing. Focus on how to interpret and use linear equations in real-world contexts.

blocks.title: Solving Linear Function Problems
blocks.description: Solve 15 linear function problems. Use 1.5 minutes per question. Focus on identifying and correcting mistakes.

blocks.title: Review Mistakes and Learn from Them
blocks.description: Go over any errors from the targeted drill. Identify patterns and write down strategies to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

days.task: Practice using evidence to support answers
days.rationale: Command of Evidence (Textual) is a critical skill for the Reading and Writing section, and practicing it will help you improve your ability to support your answers with text. This day will focus on building your confidence and accuracy with this skill.
days.completion_check: Complete the timed module and review all mistakes

blocks.title: Learn the Command of Evidence (Textual) pattern
blocks.description: Review the core rule and one worked example for Command of Evidence (Textual). Write down the decision process you should use.

blocks.title: Targeted Command of Evidence (Textual) drill
blocks.description: Complete approximately 70 adaptive questions on Command of Evidence (Textual). Pause only after submitting each answer.

blocks.title: Correct and classify mistakes
blocks.description: Redo missed and guessed questions, then record whether each miss came from knowledge, strategy, execution, or pacing.

days.focus: Ratios, rates, proportional relationships, and units
days.task: Review and practice ratios and proportional relationships
days.rationale: Ratios and proportional relationships are a key skill for the Math section, and reviewing them will help you feel more confident in solving related problems. This day will focus on building your confidence and accuracy with this skill.
days.completion_check: Complete the targeted drill and review all mistakes

blocks.title: Understanding Ratios and Proportional Relationships
blocks.description: Review the basics of ratios, rates, and proportional relationships. Focus on how to use these concepts to solve real-world problems.

blocks.title: Solving Ratio and Proportion Problems
blocks.description: Solve 15 ratio and proportion problems. Use 1.5 minutes per question. Focus on identifying and correcting mistakes.

blocks.title: Review Mistakes and Learn from Them
blocks.description: Go over any errors from the targeted drill. Identify patterns and write down strategies to avoid similar mistakes in the future.

blocks.title: Reflect on Your Progress and Plan Ahead
blocks.description: Take time to reflect on what you’ve learned this week. Think about how you can continue to improve and what you need to focus on next week.

ai_study_plan.weekly_focus: Your highest priority is building a balanced baseline.
